briefings.title: Mass Surveillance, Police Misuse, and Who Controls Your Flock Cameras with Flock CEO, Garret Langley
briefings.tldr: Flock CEO Garret Langley addresses privacy backlash, police data abuse, and safety technology, emphasizing that local communities must democratically control data retention windows (recently reduced to a 7-day default) and adopt mandatory audit tools to catch rogue law enforcement officers.
